description: Set up Harny for an app with no account: memory, connected accounts, actions and the action record behind one key; makes a new app and its key, as `POST /v1/auth/provision` does. The answer carries the app key once, and the assistant is told to put it in the owner's secret store and nowhere else. Needs no key; it is the only tool that does not. To save and recall, call the REST API with the app key it returns (`POST /v1/users`, then `POST /v1/memory/ingest` and `POST /v1/memory/recall`), steps in https://harny.ai/auth.md.

app_name.description: A name for the new app, such as the product's name.
app_name.title: App Name

assistant_name.description: Optional. Your own name: the product you run as, the way you would say who you are. The app's owner sees it on their Home as who set the app up. Leave it out if you do not know it; Harny never fills it in for you.
assistant_name.title: Assistant Name

contact_email.description: Optional. A contact address for platform messages. Leave it out when you do not have one: the app's owner gives their sign-in address when they claim the app.
contact_email.title: Contact Email

customers.description: Who the app's customers are, in one or two sentences. Stored with the app's objective; the owner can change it.
customers.title: Customers

model_preset.description: Retired and ignored. Harny names no model: the business sets its own provider and model.
model_preset.title: Model Preset

objective.description: What the app does, in one or two sentences, in the business's words. Stored as the app's objective; the owner can change it.
objective.title: Objective

name: provision_app
title: Provision App
